channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Shocking Twist in Maharashtra Caste Murder: Woman Who ‘Married’ Lover’s Corpse Levels Serious Charges at Police - The Logical Indian
item.description: 21 year old Nanded woman who married the corpse of her over makes big allegations against the Police.

item.title: 4.2-Magnitude Earthquake Hits Bay of Bengal; Authorities Report No Damage or Casualties - The Logical Indian
item.description: A moderate 4.2 magnitude earthquake struck the Bay of Bengal at 35 kilometers depth early Tuesday, causing no harm.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders Nationwide CBI Probe Into ₹3,000-Crore ‘Digital Arrest’ Scam Targeting Senior Citizens the Most - The Logical Indian
item.description: Calling the ₹3,000-crore ‘digital arrest’ racket “shocking”, the Supreme Court has given the CBI a free hand, pressed banks, states and regulators to plug loopholes, and promised to deal with the scamsters “with iron hands”.

item.title: India Allows Pakistan to Use Airspace for Aid Flight to Flood-Hit Sri Lanka - The Logical Indian
item.description: India promptly approved Pakistan’s overflight permission for its aid flight to flood-devastated Sri Lanka, rejecting media claims of refusal and underscoring regional humanitarian cooperation.

item.title: SVNIT Surat: Advaith Nair, 20, Dies After Hostel Jump, 30-Min Ambulance Delay Sparks Student Protests, Demands Reforms - The Logical Indian
item.description: A 20-year-old Kerala student's fatal hostel fall at SVNIT Surat highlights deadly emergency delays and neglected mental health, igniting campus-wide protests for accountability.

item.title: Bihar Assembly First Session: JD(U) MLA Vibha Devi Stumbles While Reading Hindi Oath; Video Goes Viral - The Logical Indian
item.description: Vibha Devi, from a powerful political family, faced criticism online after struggling to read her oath in Hindi.

item.title: Maharashtra Woman Alleges Husband Delivered ‘Triple Talaq’ via Courier from Canada, FIR Filed Against Family in Nashik - The Logical Indian
item.description: A woman in Nashik alleges instant divorce through couriered triple talaq from abroad, prompting legal action.

item.title: Sadhguru at INSIGHT: India Risks Losing Its Demographic Dividend If Growth Doesn’t Accelerate - The Logical Indian
item.description: Youthful India stands at a critical juncture; embracing growth and reform is essential to fully realize its demographic advantage and avoid future challenges.

item.title: Bengaluru’s Rameshwaram Cafe Owners Booked After Flyer Alleges Worm in Food - The Logical Indian
item.description: Rameshwaram Cafe owners face FIR for allegedly selling noxious food and fabricating charges against a customer.

item.title: Opposition Stages Parliament Protest Against SIR, Accuses Government of ‘Vote Chori’ - The Logical Indian
item.description: Opposition leaders including Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge protested at Parliament's Makar Dwar against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), demanding electoral reforms amid reports of over 20 BLO deaths and session disruptions.​
